profile.headline: HP Asset Manager Software Engineer at General Motors
profile.summary:
• 5+ years of technical ITAM experience working with HP AssetCenter, Connect-It, and Enterprise Discovery as an developer and administrator. 

• 20+ years of technical experience working as an IT Engineer working on web, client server and mainframe applications. 

• Extensive Project Management Experience working on Information Technology projects. 

• Expertise in Asset Management Systems, ERP systems and Supply Chain systems.

Specialties: HP Certified Professional - Accredited Integration Specialist HP Asset Management Software v4.x and v5.x

positions.title: HP Asset Manager Software Engineer
positions.description: Supporting HP Asset Manager at General Motors.

positions.title: Sr. Systems Engineer
positions.description: Technical consultant that specializes in IBM Mainframe applications.  Also, specializes in HP Openview Products - Asset Manager 5.x, DDMI 7.x, Connect-it 4.x  Extensive experience in the Software Development Lifecycle for both IBM Mainframe and Client server environments.

positions.title: Sr. Systems Consultant
positions.description:
• Possess extensive technical experience working with HP/Peregrine AssetCenter, HP/Peregrine Connect-It 3.x, HP/Peregrine AssetCenter Web, HP/Peregrine Database Administrator and HP/Peregrine Get-Resources.  Moreover, extensive technical experience with Peregrine workflow development, imports, exports, wizards, Connect-It scenario development and Asset Center basic programming scripts. Technical experience with HP/Peregrine Get-Resources personalization interface, development of schema extensions, HP/Peregrine Portal configurations and development of tree menu enhancements.   
• Extensive project Management experience with the following project management skills:  develop project plans using Microsoft Project, assigning development task to available resources, management of project budget, and management of technical issues.
• Possess extensive Database experience.  This includes IBM DB2 SQL, DB2 SPUFI, ORACLE SQL and Microsoft SQL Server.

positions.description: Technical Environment: Peregrine AssetCenter 4.4.1, Peregrine Get-Resources 4.2, Peregrine Database Administrator 4.4.1, Peregrine Connect-It 3.x, Peregrine Service Center, Geac AP:M, PO:M, FA:M, Microsoft Office Suite, Microsoft Windows Server 2003, Oracle 9.0, Microsoft SQL Server, Peregrine VB Script, Peregrine Workflow, Peregrine Wizards, Apache Webserver, Tomcat 4.1, Windows XP, IBM OS/390, CICS, MVS, DB2, OS/COBOL, VSAM, JCL, ISPF, TSO.

projects.title: HP ASSET MANAGER
projects.description:
•	Developed Asset Manager wizard interface to track Delta Airline Motorola Portable hand held Radios
•	Upgraded UCMDB to version 9.05
•	Developed AM/UCMDB Connect-it interface to pass too UCMDB the Delta barcode Tag Number and to pass back to AM the UCMDB-id.
•	Developed Service Manager/UCMDB interface to pass too UCMDB Assignment Group information via Service Manager web services (WSDL) using connect-it scenario. 
•	Created Workstation Inventory interface using HP Connect-It from HP Client Automation (Radia), this interface handles more than 45,000 assets that includes desktops, laptops and kiosk.  Also, this interface post to Asset Manager all software installation counts that are used for Software Asset Tracking.
•	Developed Asset Manager wizard enhancements for warehouse barcode label printing for both LDAP and non-LDAP workstations.
•	Developed Asset Manager wizard enhancements for printing multiple labels for warehouse non-asset tagged items.
•	Developed Asset Manger warehouse wizard enhancements to shipping and receiving wizards to allow ability to search for asset based upon serial number. 
•	Developed HP Connect-it scenario to migrate Radio assets from HP Service Manager 7.02.  Also, developed Asset Manager wizards to add new models, part numbers and new Radio assets.  This migration posted over 25,000 assets from Service Manager to Asset manager.
